name: gq-support
description: WordPress plugin: in-dashboard chat for editors/admins to report bugs

scripts.wp:start: ddev start gq-support-for-wp-testsite && pnpm run wp:update
scripts.wp:update: ddev exec -p gq-support-for-wp-testsite composer update roots/wordpress --with-all-dependencies --no-interaction && ddev exec -p gq-support-for-wp-testsite wp plugin update --all
scripts.wp:check: ddev exec -p gq-support-for-wp-testsite wp plugin check gq-support
